g.aria-label: Step 1 · Form Candidate Bag V = (Y₁, Y₂, …, Y_N) with Y₁ = Y⁺ and Y_{2:N} ~ P_Y^{⊗(N−1)}
Chain Rule: I(X; V) = I(X; Y₁) + I(X; Y_{2:N} | Y₁) = I(X; Y) + 0 = I(X; Y)
Step 2 · Rescaled Softmax γ(x, v) = N e^{T(x,y₁)} / ∑_j e^{T(x,y_j)} Normalizes q(v | x)
By permutation symmetry of p(v) = ∏ p_Y(y_j): E_{p(v)}[γ(x, V)] = 1 ⇒ q(v|x) = p(v)γ(x,v)
Step 3 · Apply Barber–Agakov Ratio Bound to (X, V)
I(X; Y) = I(X; V) ≥ E[log(q(V|X) / p(V))] = E[log γ(X, V)] = log N − L_NCE
